design: SIH26009 schema-faithful synthetic demo generator v3
geology_row_meaning: synthetic assay/interval observation associated with a real MOIL mine; mine coordinates are map anchors, not claimed sample coordinates

economic_model.price: static lookup by mine + Mn grade band; official IBM ex-mine reference where available, otherwise median official-reference fallback
economic_model.cost: static mine-level production-cost lookup where available, otherwise median official-reference fallback
economic_model.warning: profit_proxy_inr is indicative gross margin only; not accounting/net profit

warnings: Do not call estimated_tonnage_proxy_t a certified reserve/resource estimate.
Do not sum synthetic observation tonnage proxies into a mine reserve/profit total until real non-overlapping spatial blocks/geometry are available.
Do not interpret synthetic satellite covariance as a manganese spectral law.
Do not interpret synthetic chemistry correlations as calibrated MOIL geology.
Dongri Buzurg production target uses a historical capacity proxy, not a same-period IBM annual plan.
Tirodi and Dongri Buzurg map points should be replaced with official lease/DGPS/KML geometry when obtained.
Replace synthetic rainfall with IMD; satellite reflectance with Sentinel-2/ASTER; and operational records with MOIL data when available.

v4_update.purpose: Add soil-moisture columns so the direct-ROM shortfall model can train on satellite/space-tech telemetry alongside rainfall, downtime and blast delay, per the problem statement's satellite-input line.
v4_update.generation: soil_moisture_pct is generated realistically: it rises with the same-day rainfall, decays toward a dry baseline when conditions are dry, is bounded roughly 3-60%, and carries small noise; soil_moisture_3d_avg / soil_moisture_7d_avg are trailing rolling averages matching the existing rain_3d_mm / rain_7d_mm pattern; soil_moisture_source flags each row as synthetic.
v4_update.honesty_note: Soil-moisture values are synthetic demo data only. They must be swapped for a real satellite product (e.g. NASA SMAP or ISRO Bhuvan) before deployment.
v4_update.model_mapping: scripts/train_shortfall_model.py NUMERIC_FEATURES includes soil_moisture_pct, soil_moisture_3d_avg, soil_moisture_7d_avg; modules/prediction.py feeds the same columns into predict_actual_rom_output.

v5_update.purpose: Rebuild the production dataset with a threshold/piecewise rainfall penalty, rain-driven downtime and blast-delay causality (chain reaction), and a single soil-moisture feature so the shortfall model reflects realistic monsoon operational behaviour.
changes_vs_v4: rainfall penalty is piecewise/threshold: 0 below 40mm/day, ramping 40-100mm, sharp up to ~36% above 100mm (monsoon-shutdown-like)
equipment_downtime_hours and blast_delay_minutes are PARTIALLY CAUSED by rainfall (chain reaction) plus their own independent random component
soil_moisture_pct retained; soil_moisture_3d_avg / soil_moisture_7d_avg dropped (VIF 45-141 in v4)
monthlyTarget / target_rom_tonnes are dashboard scenario inputs, never model features
v5_update.base_capacity_anchor: mine-level base capacities calibrated from MOIL annual report figures (annual production / 365 / mine share); the only literature-anchored numbers
v5_update.model_mapping: scripts/train_shortfall_model.py trains on data/processed_production_v5.csv; modules/prediction.py builds rain_x_downtime at inference time
v5_update.honesty_note: Weather/ops coefficients remain documented synthetic design choices (no public per-mine daily dataset exists); replace synthetic rainfall with IMD and operational records with MOIL data before deployment.

interaction_update.purpose: Add the engineered rain_x_downtime = rainfall_mm x equipment_downtime_hours interaction to the direct-ROM OLS so compounding of heavy rain WITH prolonged equipment downtime is captured beyond the additive main effects.
interaction_update.decision: rain_x_downtime is significant (p = 0.0001) and retained; the other two candidate interactions (rain_x_blast, soil_x_downtime) were tested and dropped as not significant.
interaction_update.scaling: raw (OLS fit on unnormalised features; numeric_feature_caps kept only for dashboard stress/penalty display)

verification.default_sliders: rainfall 88.5, soil 38, downtime 6, blast 45, labor 18, Balaghat, target 900
